about: Second Kingdoms (2 Samuel) tells about King David, who loved God, made mistakes and asked God to forgive him.

pages.title: David Becomes King
pages.scene: King David dancing as the ark comes into Jerusalem
pages.text: David became king over all of Israel. He made Jerusalem his city. When God's special box came into the city, David was so happy that he danced with all his might! Everyone shouted and played music.
pages.lesson: Praise God with all your heart.

pages.title: Kindness to Mephibosheth
pages.scene: Mephibosheth eating at King David's table
pages.text: David remembered his promise to his friend Jonathan. He found Jonathan's son, Mephibosheth, whose feet were hurt. David said, "Don't be afraid. You will eat at my table every day, like one of my sons."
pages.lesson: Keep your promises and be kind.

pages.title: David Says Sorry
pages.scene: Nathan the prophet talking to sad King David
pages.text: King David did something very wrong. He took another man's wife. God sent the prophet Nathan to tell David a story that showed him his sin. David said, "I have sinned against the Lord." He was truly sorry, and God forgave him.
pages.lesson: When you do wrong, say sorry to God.
